title: Felmondás, karbantartás és kiköltözés
grammar: Termination & Restitution: Felmondási idő, Karbantartás & Kaució

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say that a termination must be in writing.
I can say when the deposit is returned when I move out.
I can understand short sentences about repairs, painting and damage.
